inicio.kicker: Course · step 3 of From chat to agent · 7 lessons
inicio.titulo: Queues: send ten tasks, go to sleep and check the result in the morning
inicio.lead: An agent in a chat does one thing at a time, and only while you watch. In this course you build your own queue: you decide what goes in, understand the homemade queue, install inemaccbot, put gates before what matters, and learn to check the batch the next day.
inicio.capa_alt: Office at night with a laptop showing a list of completed tasks and a phone beside it.
inicio.aulas_sub: In the order you do them: first understand and decide, then install, send, add gates and check. Prerequisite: steps 1 (terminal) and 2 (your Jarvis) of the program.

itens: People who already use an agent in the terminal (step 1) and have an assistant with rules (step 2).
People who repeat the same tasks every week: transcribing, summarizing, drafting, generating video.
People who want to leave the computer working at night without fear of losing what was done.
Sort your tasks into: goes to the queue, goes with a gate, stays with you.
Run a homemade queue and see it resume after an interruption.
Install inemaccbot until /ping answers in your Telegram.
Send a batch overnight, approve at the gate and measure in the morning how many came out right on the first try.
Turn the task that failed the most into a new rule.
